title: Subagent verdict
description: Every subagent returns exactly one JSON object of this shape and nothing else. engine/board.py record-verdict validates it.

subject.description: Exact subject ID from CLAUDE.md section 6

data_quality.description: UNVERIFIED_INPUTS if any input carries [[UNVERIFIED]] or a needed fact is assumed

summary_ar.description: Two to four sentences in Arabic: the decision and the reason

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE identifier, e.g. NO_LD_CLAUSE, UNSERVICEABLE_PLC

fix.description: Exact change that would clear the finding

conditions.description: Conditions attached to an APPROVED verdict

evidence.description: Repo relative paths actually reviewed. The engine hashes them.

extra.description: Agent specific structured output (spare parts BOM, risk scores, journal proposals, schedule)
